# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 10
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Community Rule Column 10 where the three translators significantly diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 10:1 | "With-the-coming-of day-and-night" | "With the coming of day and night" | "When day and night arrive" | Structural | LOGOS — formal register suits liturgical text |
| 2 | 10:2 | "with-no turning-back" | "with no turning back" | "never turn back" | Word choice | LOGOS — preserves Hebrew idiom |
| 3 | 10:3 | "as-an-engraved-decree" | "as an engraved decree" | "like an inscription cut in stone" | Interpretive | LOGOS — "engraved decree" is closer to choq charut |
| 4 | 10:3 | "And-to-God I-will-say, 'My-righteousness'" | "To God I will say, 'My Righteousness'" | "To God I will say, 'You are my Righteousness'" | Structural | LOGOS — adding "You are" is interpretive expansion |
| 5 | 10:4 | "Source-of-knowledge and-Spring-of holiness" | "Source of knowledge and Spring of holiness" | "the wellspring of all I know, the fountain of what is holy" | Word choice | LOGOS — PNEUMA's paraphrase dilutes the Hebrew parallelism |
| 6 | 10:5 | "Almighty-One-of eternal-majesty" | "Almighty One of eternal majesty" | "the Almighty whose splendor lasts forever" | Word choice | LOGOS — closer to Hebrew construct chain |
| 7 | 10:5 | "I-will-be-pleased with-how He-judges-me" | "I will be content with how He judges me" | "accept however He judges me" | Word choice | SOPHIA compromise — "accept" (clearer than "content") |
| 8 | 10:7 | "their-storehouse" | "their storehouse" | "their treasury" | Word choice | LOGOS — otsar is "storehouse" not "treasury" in this context |
| 9 | 10:8 | "when-the-luminaries shine-forth" | "when the luminaries shine forth" | "when the heavenly lights shine out" | Word choice | LOGOS — "luminaries" preserves me'orot |
| 10 | 10:11 | "a-great-day for-the-Holy-of-Holies" | "a great day for the Holy of Holies" | "a magnificent day, most sacred of all" | Interpretive | LOGOS — "Holy of Holies" is a fixed expression (qodesh ha-qodashim) |
| 11 | 10:12 | "for-the-opening-of His-eternal-mercies" | "for the opening of His eternal mercies" | "that His eternal mercy is being revealed" | Structural | LOGOS — PNEUMA's participial reworking changes the force |
| 12 | 10:15 | "With-an-offering-of the-lips" | "With an offering of the lips" | "With words of praise" | Word choice | LOGOS — "offering of the lips" preserves sacrificial metaphor |
| 13 | 10:18 | "harvest-time to summer, sowing-time to green-growth" | "harvest time to summer, sowing time to green growth" | "harvest yielding to summer heat, planting time yielding to fresh green shoots" | Structural | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds words not in the Hebrew |
| 14 | 10:20 | "a-season-of liberation" | "a season of liberation" | "a season of freedom and release" | Word choice | LOGOS — single word deror = "liberation"; hendiadys unnecessary |
| 15 | 10:22 | "I-will-sing with-knowledge" | "I will sing with knowledge" | "I will sing with understanding" | Word choice | LOGOS — da'at is "knowledge" not merely "understanding" |
| 16 | 10:24 | "in-His-just-measure" | "in His just measure" | "to His perfect standard" | Word choice | LOGOS — mishpat here means "measure/ordinance" not "standard" |

---

**Summary:** 16 disagreements logged. LOGOS prevailed in 14 cases, SOPHIA offered a compromise in 1, and no EMET or PNEUMA readings were adopted as primary. The liturgical-hymnic register of Column 10 strongly favored formal equivalence; PNEUMA's expansions consistently introduced words absent from the Hebrew, while EMET's hyphenation was the only systematic difference from LOGOS.
